reference: Z3 qfnra-nlsat, independently replayed exact SMT-LIB
scope: 16 default exact search/model/proof and checked full-CAD differential cases, plus one preserved optional stress input checked only by external Z3
full_reference_policy: Original quadratic-in-z case 14 remains as an optional stress input: neither full nor pruned morph completion is claimed. The default cohort uses a distinct, explicitly named affine replacement. --emit-full-stress emits the original input test under .tools, outside default package tests.

stress_cost_observation.classification: unresolved cost, not wrong result and not passed

input_coefficients: Fraction/QQ; no floats or approximate roots

cases.name: sector sample is not a cylindrical truth
cases.closed_form_reason: x=y=1; y=x is not constant over the suffix at x=1.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (> (+ (* 1 x0)) 0) (= (+ (* (- 1) x0) (* 1 x1)) 0)))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: negative sector square root
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (< (+ (* 1 x0)) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x0) (* 1 x1 x1)) 0)))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: positive sector square root obstruction
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (> (+ (* 1 x0)) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x0) (* 1 x1 x1)) 0)))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: irrational section nullifies an impossible affine fibre
cases.closed_form_reason: At both roots of x^2-2, the second polynomial is -1.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* (- 2))) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0 x1) (* (- 2) x1) (* (- 1))) 0)))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: irrational section nullifies a free suffix
cases.closed_form_reason: x=sqrt(2) makes the entire y cylinder valid.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* (- 2))) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0 x1) (* (- 2) x1)) 0)))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: combined coefficient cancellation leaves nonzero constant
cases.closed_form_reason: x=1 kills the y coefficient and leaves -1.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0) (* (- 1))) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x0 x1) (* 1 x0) (* (- 1) x1) (* (- 2))) 0)))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: closed boundary forbids strictly positive nullified product
cases.closed_form_reason: The closed bounds force x=0, hence xy=0.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (>= (+ (* 1 x0)) 0) (and (<= (+ (* 1 x0)) 0) (> (+ (* 1 x0 x1)) 0))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: closed boundary admits nonnegative nullified product
cases.closed_form_reason: x=0 makes xy=0 for every y.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (>= (+ (* 1 x0)) 0) (and (<= (+ (* 1 x0)) 0) (>= (+ (* 1 x0 x1)) 0))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: irrational section rejects disequality after nullification
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* (- 2))) 0) (distinct (+ (* 1 x0 x0 x1) (* (- 2) x1)) 0)))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: negative scaling retains relation orientation
cases.closed_form_reason: x=0 leaves positive constant 2, not a negative value.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0)) 0) (< (+ (* (- 3) x0 x1) (* 2)) 0)))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: Boolean alternative closes sectors and nullified sections
cases.closed_form_reason: When d is nonzero the first disjunct holds; when d=0 the second is 1>0.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (or (distinct (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* (- 2))) 0) (> (+ (* 1 x0 x0 x1) (* (- 2) x1) (* 1)) 0)))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: exact rational coefficient nullification
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0) (* (/ (- 1) 3))) 0) (>= (+ (* 3 x0 x1) (* (- 1) x1) (* (- 2))) 0)))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: negated strict boundary survives at section
cases.closed_form_reason: x=0 gives xy=0 and negates strict positivity.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0)) 0) (not (> (+ (* 1 x0 x1)) 0))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: same future monomial combines several prefix terms
cases.closed_form_reason: At x=2 the grouped y coefficient is 4-6+2=0 and constant 3 remains.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0) (* (- 2))) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0 x1) (* (- 3) x0 x1) (* 2 x1) (* 3)) 0)))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: three coordinate affine coefficient vanishes before contradictory constant
cases.closed_form_reason: x=0 removes the z coefficient; y=1 then leaves -1. This tractable affine regression replaces the separately preserved quadratic-in-z stress input.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(declare-fun x2 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0)) 0) (and (= (+ (* 1 x1) (* (- 1))) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x0 x2) (* 1 x1) (* (- 2))) 0))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: three coordinate nullification admits full last cylinder
cases.closed_form_reason: x=0,y=1 makes the last polynomial zero for every z.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(declare-fun x2 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0)) 0) (and (= (+ (* 1 x1) (* (- 1))) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x0 x2 x2) (* 1 x1 x2) (* (- 1) x2)) 0))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: three coordinate two future coefficients vanish
cases.closed_form_reason: At x=0,y=1 both z coefficients vanish and -1 remains. Exact Z3 UNSAT; morph execution is a censored cost observation, not a completed result.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(declare-fun x2 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0)) 0) (and (= (+ (* 1 x1) (* (- 1))) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x0 x2 x2) (* 1 x1 x2) (* (- 1) x2) (* (- 1))) 0))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)
